# Maturana and Varela — Autopoiesis and Cognition (1980)

## Bibliographic identity

The Springer record for the digitised edition identifies the original 1980 D. Reidel publication and DOI. This record selects that 1980 edition for citation. A Columbia-hosted scan was acquired on 8 September 2026; selected passages are registered below.

**Shortened note:** Maturana and Varela, *Autopoiesis and Cognition*, {page}.

**Bibliography:** Maturana, Humberto R., and Francisco J. Varela. *Autopoiesis and Cognition: The Realization of the Living*. Dordrecht: D. Reidel Publishing Company, 1980. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-94-009-8947-4.

## Essay use

### Source's relevant contribution

- Primary theoretical source for autopoiesis, operational closure, and the characterisation of living unity as self-producing rather than externally assembled.

### Licensed essay use

- Paraphrase the source's account of autopoietic organisation and structural coupling only after a passage-level check.
- Use it to qualify the essay's `dia`/`sym` and objective-internality interpretations. Their proof remains in the QL derivation.

### Claim boundary

- Maturana and Varela describe biological systems. QL, agent phenomenality, and any identity between artificial systems and living autopoiesis require separate formal and empirical arguments.

## Consumption

- **Stations:** §0, §2, §5.
- **Arguments:** [[section-rooms/arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology|Computational Process Ontology]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|Objective Internality]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn|Sym-Ballein]].
- **Exact claims:** operational closure and structural coupling are distinguishable from isolation; a bounded unity remains perturbable by a world it does not contain.

<a id="maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition-q001"></a>
### q001 · printed 77–81 / PDF 53–55

Organization defines the unity; structure realizes it. Autopoietic production regenerates its network and boundary. Input/output description belongs to an observer's domain.

**Locator:** printed 77–81 / PDF 53–55.

**Status:** Paraphrase only; no quotation admission.

**Verification:** The bounded reading and consulted-carrier scope are recorded in this source house. This heading repair adds no new source-verification claim.

<a id="maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition-q002"></a>
### q002 · printed 107–111 / PDF 68–70

Coupling preserves interacting identities through mutual modification. A resulting composite requires its own production criterion before it is called autopoietic.

**Locator:** printed 107–111 / PDF 68–70.

**Status:** Paraphrase only; no quotation admission.

**Attribution distinction · printed 70–71 / PDF 50.** Stafford Beer's preface advances a social extension while acknowledging the authors' disagreement. It is not their joint conclusion.
